title: Aquarius: what to know
description: The essentials of Aquarius in a few screens: strengths, challenges, love and work.

pages.title: Aquarius: the basics
pages.text: Approximate dates: Jan 20 - Feb 18. Air element, fixed quality, ruled by Uranus (and Saturn in classical astrology).

pages.title: Originality
pages.text: Aquarius thinks differently, values freedom and brings ideas nobody had considered.

pages.title: Distance
pages.text: Can seem cold or detached when they need to think. Saying what they feel brings people closer.

pages.title: Friendship first
pages.text: Likes mental connection and respect for space. Love grows on top of partnership.

pages.title: The one who innovates
pages.text: Does well in technology, group causes and projects that change how things are done.
